title: Kelly Boesch Official Music Video - Pretty Things - 4K
description:
'Pretty Things' is an intimate look at the struggle between the body and the soul. I wanted to write something that ignores the mirror and instead judges worth by the invisible...the 'pretty things' we say and the messy, beautiful chaos of the brain. It’s not about being okay; it’s about being heard.

One of my favorite things to do with ai is come up with interesting characters. I was playing around with puppets. I actually love puppets and puppet shows. Having the ability to make my own puppets is magical. I am really a child at heart and still love fairytales and stories. I hope to give people the dreamy feeling of a fairytale like story with my videos. I put a lot of thought into these videos and personal feelings. I've not been posting daily as I used to so I can have some time between each video to really be thoughtful about what I post. I have also been extremely busy and making sure I don't burn out is important. :-)Thank all of you for your continued support and beautiful, uplifting comments. They mean the world to me. 

Lyrics written by me, Kelly Boesch. Music created under my creative direction with assistance from Suno.
